text: I think you'll really enjoy the Tomato and Basil Orzo Salad recipe. It's a perfect combination of flavors and textures that should satisfy your love for pasta and tomato. The orzo pasta is a great base, and the fresh basil and tomatoes add a burst of freshness. The parmesan cheese provides a nice salty kick, but don't worry, it's nut-free, so it fits within your dietary constraints. Plus, the recipe is quick and easy to make, which fits within your 45-minute time budget. Give it a try!
